title: 第2264章 石油还能卖钱第2263章 十连跳啊
lines: 又是几天后，大明乾清宫，等朱由检接到新的汇报，说是从南都运来的由李维贤知府献出的一百万两白银，已经点算结束压入内库，少年皇帝都懵逼的厉害。
这一批白银刚从南都出发，当地锦衣卫已经快马加鞭来了京师汇报消息，甚至把白银的出处，全是李知府一行拍卖的海外珍宝所得，也标注清楚了。
可朱由检还是不敢相信，自己只是任性的，你给我吹一个牛，我就给你个位置让你完成吹牛任务的方式，提升了一个知府，这就真的得到了一百万两？？
你这是不拿银子当钱用么？
弯弯此刻还没有怎么被大明开发过，属于化外之地，这样的地方比琼州还要偏僻落后，属于不毛之地，但这，就能换一百万两？还是第一笔？
放下手里奏章，朱由检才好奇看向王承恩，“那位李维贤在南都招募的幕僚是怎么说的？他想要什么？”
王承恩果断道，“回皇爷，那位李知府想要石油，就是前宋沈括所著梦溪笔谈中提到的石油，状如醍醐，甚臭，又称为石脂水，可以点燃燃烧，那位田秀才说，李知府需要这种石油，去当做燃料催动他们在海外制造的船只。”
朱由检一脸木然，“船不是木头造的么？还需要燃烧的石油做燃烧？”
他知道灯油是烧起来照明的，算是燃料，可船……石油？
懵逼片刻，甩甩头甩飞了这个念头，朱由检才好奇问道，“我大明都在哪里有石油？”
王承恩，“那位田秀才说，最容易采集石油的地带，当属陕西延长等地，部分地带在地表就可以采集，大部分地区，也只需要挖地深几十步就能找到，用铁桶装起来运输，但陕西若是太远运输不便，山东乐安县也有，不过乐安县的石油怕是要挖地四五百步深，才能发现这些石油。”
朱由检再次懵了一阵子才开口，“这一百万两银子，只是他们请朕给他们这个收集石油的权利，以后，按照李维贤提供的铁桶标准，一桶十两？”
“快去把他们准备的铁桶拿来，朕要看看这桶有多大！”
一段时间后，等少年皇帝真的见到了油桶，再次震惊了，“这么小？”
李维贤等人提供的铁桶装满了原油也就是一立方米，六七桶装一吨原油。
看起来价格不算低，七十两银子一桶原油？？
可不要忘了，物价以及世界环境代差！
他们只要有足够原油，抢了西方殖民者的海图，那么一艘排水量五万吨的大游轮就是海上巨无霸，无敌舰队，跑的也比帆船快得多，就算用明代的铁器加装一些撞角什么的，都是打遍天下无敌手。
这个时代，海洋上又有多少运金运银船？
西班牙的运金运银船，这年头依旧在跑得欢快呢。只要有足够原料，以现代邮轮的速度，从弯弯杀到马尼拉能用几天？
搞出来柴油之后，依靠游轮上的几座柴油发电机，依旧能过上夜生活。
这个基业立起来，李维贤也得到了知府头衔，那么不管在弯弯怎么移民管理开发，都是名正言顺，他们会飞速发展壮大。
所以在朱由检看来，这么便宜的油价，绝对是超值爆赚。
他也早听说了，那些地方你只要挖出来，几乎就像是泉水一样源源不断等着你搞的石油。都是埋在大地之下等着废弃的东西，竟然还能卖钱？？
震惊过后，朱由检才兴奋道，“马上传旨给孙传庭，他已经是陕西巡抚，延长就在他治下，不是训练新兵没钱么？只要他挖出油，就不会缺钱。”
“乐安那边也要去做，两手准备，另外，派东厂番子和锦衣卫，秘密入弯，朕要尽快知道，他们的船为什么需要燃料，木船上可以随便生火燃烧么？？”
李维贤提供的延长、乐安两个地点，当然不是只说了一下县名就结束的，哪个县也不小，你不知道准确位置很难找的。
他提供的是大致详细的地址，这是游轮上八九百客人里，就有一个油田出身的工人，还算是技术工种，爆的料。
有时候人多，本身就是一种财富啊。
一千多人，游轮上也有电脑之类设备，储备的有一部分资料，就是许多人的手机里，都未必没储备一些现代知识资料等等，基地立起来，他们想发展，真的不难。
目前群穿客们已经在大肆找资料，详细推敲，该如何把粗炼的柴油在搞的标准化一些呢。
对李维贤等人来说，石油就是无上财富，可对朱由检来说，这也是白捡的财富，上千年来就没怎么听说过，那些东西有什么大用的，从地里挖出来就能像是粮食一样换钱？
这年头，陕西一带无数人吃不起饭饿的不得不造反时，你只要有东西能换钱，在能用钱换粮食，还怕找不到人挖石油运石油？
就在这时，少年皇帝又想到了一件事，“入库的一百万两，拨给孙卿六十万，让他好好主持他的以工代赈策略，之前孙卿上书想平定陕西，剿虽然重要，可最根本还是让广大百姓吃得上饭。”
“他奏章中说前宋就经常在发生灾害时，用以工代赈的方式让百姓靠卖劳力吃得起饭，现在没了辽饷，再配合这一招，应该能大大缓解陕西的民变烈度。”
两年多前陕西有王二等贼头发动民变荼毒四方，高迎祥在去年反了，李自成今年反了，可现在才崇祯二年11月，那里的各种民变声势还谈不上大，尤其是，初期的民乱都是老百姓扛着锄头或木棍就造反了。
只要有足够的粮食，想要彻底平定希望很大，有了足够银子，那就代表着粮食。
朱由检目前还谈不上合格的统治者，但经过几个仙君提点后，知道了孙传庭、卢象升等人都是大才，孙传庭赴任陕西后第一道奏章就提到了以工代赈，还列举了前宋的例子。
数据中，前宋一共发生上千起较大自然灾害，平均一年就两三次，水灾、旱灾、雨雹灾、风灾、蝗灾等等，就是依靠成熟的赈灾体系，前宋才撑下来的，并不是亡于自然灾害。
朱由检觉得孙传庭说的很有道理，现在有了钱，还能有新的卖石油来钱渠道，不能错过啊。
content_en:
A few days later, in the Qianqing Palace of the Ming Dynasty, when Zhu Youjian received a new report, it was said that one million taels of silver shipped from Nandu and donated by the prefect Li Weixian had been counted and put into the inner treasury. The young emperor was extremely confused.
This batch of silver had just set off from Nandu, and the local Jin Yiwei had already rushed to the capital to report the news. They even clearly marked the provenance of the silver, which was obtained from overseas treasures auctioned by Magistrate Li and his party.
But Zhu Youjian still can't believe that he is just willful. If you brag to me, I will give you a position to complete the bragging task and promote you to a prefect. Do you really get one million taels? ?
Are you not using money as money?
Wanwan has not been developed by the Ming Dynasty at this moment, and it belongs to a foreign land. This kind of place is more remote and backward than Qiongzhou, and it is a barren land, but this can be exchanged for one million taels? Or the first one?
Putting down the memorial in his hand, Zhu Youjian looked at Wang Chengen curiously, "What did the staff Li Weixian recruited in Nandu say? What does he want?"
Wang Chengen said decisively, "Back to the emperor, the prefect Li wants oil. It is the oil mentioned in Mengxi Essays written by Shen Kuo of the former Song Dynasty. It looks like glutinous rice wine and is very smelly. It is also called sludge water and can be ignited and burned. That Tian Xiucai said that prefect Li needs this oil to use it as fuel to drive the ships they built overseas."
Zhu Youjian looked blank, "Isn't the boat made of wood? Does it still need burning oil for combustion?"
He knew that lamp oil was burned for lighting and was considered fuel, but the boat... oil?
After being confused for a moment, Zhu Youjian shook his head to get rid of this idea, and asked curiously, "Where is the oil in Ming Dynasty?"
Wang Chengen, "Tian Xiucai said that the easiest place to collect oil is in places such as Yanchang, Shaanxi. Some areas can be collected on the surface. In most areas, you only need to dig a few dozen steps deep to find it and transport it in iron barrels. But if Shaanxi is too far and transportation is inconvenient, it is also available in Le'an County, Shandong. However, the oil in Le'an County may have to be dug four to five hundred steps deep to find the oil."
Zhu Youjian was confused again for a while before speaking, "This one million taels of silver is just because they asked me to give them the right to collect oil. From now on, according to the standard of the iron barrel provided by Li Weixian, it will be ten taels per barrel?"
"Go and get the iron bucket they prepared. I want to see how big this bucket is!"
After a while, when the young emperor actually saw the oil barrel, he was shocked again, "So small?"
The iron barrels provided by Li Weixian and others are filled with one cubic meter of crude oil, and six or seven barrels hold one ton of crude oil.
The price doesn't seem low, seventy taels of silver per barrel of crude oil? ?
But don’t forget about price differences and global environmental differences!
As long as they have enough crude oil and steal the nautical charts of the Western colonists, then a large cruise ship with a displacement of 50,000 tons will be a giant on the sea, an invincible fleet, and it can run much faster than a sailboat. Even if they use Ming Dynasty iron tools and add some collision angles, they will be invincible in the world.
In this era, how many gold and silver ships are there on the ocean?
Spain's gold and silver ships are still running happily these days. As long as there are enough raw materials, at the speed of a modern cruise ship, how many days will it take to get from Wanwan to Manila?
After the development of diesel, nightlife can still be maintained by relying on several diesel generators on cruise ships.
With this foundation established and Li Weixian also getting the title of prefect, no matter how the immigration management and development is done in Wanwan, it will be justified and they will develop rapidly.
Therefore, in Zhu Youjian's view, such a cheap oil price is definitely a huge profit.
He has also heard that as long as you dig out those places, there will be a steady stream of oil waiting for you, almost like spring water. They are all buried under the earth waiting to be discarded, but they can still be sold for money? ?
After the shock, Zhu Youjian said excitedly, "Immediately send an order to Sun Chuanting. He is already the governor of Shaanxi, and Yanchang is under his rule. Isn't there no money to train new recruits? As long as he digs out the oil, there will be no shortage of money."
"Le'an also needs to do it. Be prepared with both hands. In addition, send Dongchang Fanzi and Jinyiwei to sneak in secretly. I want to know as soon as possible why their ship needs fuel. Can they light a fire casually on a wooden ship?"
Of course, the two locations Li Weixian provided, namely Yanchang and Le'an, did not end with just mentioning the name of the county. No county is small, and it is difficult to find the exact location if you don't know the exact location.
What he provided was a rough and detailed address. It was revealed that among the eight to nine hundred guests on the cruise ship, there was a worker with an oil field background, who was considered a skilled worker.
Sometimes having too many people is a kind of wealth in itself.
There are more than a thousand people, and there are computers and other equipment on the cruise ship. Some of the information is stored in many people's mobile phones. They may not have some modern knowledge materials, etc. Once the base is established, it is really not difficult for them to develop.
At present, a group of passengers are already searching for information and scrutinizing in detail how to standardize crudely refined diesel.
For Li Weixian and others, oil is the ultimate wealth, but for Zhu Youjian, this is also wealth picked up for free. He has not heard of it for thousands of years. What is the use of those things? They can be dug out of the ground and exchanged for money like food?
These days, when countless people in Shaanxi cannot afford food and are so hungry that they have to rebel, as long as you have something to exchange for money, and you can exchange money for food, are you afraid that you can't find anyone to dig for oil and transport it?
At this moment, the young emperor thought of another thing, "The one million taels put into the treasury will be allocated 600,000 to Sun Qing, so that he can properly manage his work-for-relief strategy. Previously, Sun Qing wrote a letter to pacify Shaanxi. Although suppression is important, the most fundamental thing is to ensure that the people have enough to eat."
"He said in the memorial that in the Song Dynasty, the former Song Dynasty often used the work-for-relief method to allow the people to afford food by selling their labor. Now that there is no Liao salary, this method should be able to greatly reduce the intensity of the civil unrest in Shaanxi."
More than two years ago in Shaanxi, thieves such as Wang Er launched a civil uprising to wreak havoc in all directions. Gao Yingxiang rebelled last year, and Li Zicheng rebelled this year. However, it is only November of the second year of Chongzhen, and the various civil uprisings there are not that big. Especially in the early civil unrest, ordinary people rebelled with hoes or wooden sticks.
As long as there is enough food, there is great hope for complete pacification. If there is enough money, it means food.
Zhu Youjian could not be said to be a qualified ruler at present, but after several immortal kings' suggestions, he learned that Sun Chuanting, Lu Xiangsheng and others were all great talents. Sun Chuanting's first memorial after he took office in Shaanxi mentioned the use of work in lieu of relief, and also cited examples from the previous Song Dynasty.
According to the data, there were thousands of major natural disasters in the former Song Dynasty, an average of two or three times a year, including floods, droughts, rain and hail, wind disasters, locust plagues, etc. It was only through the mature disaster relief system that the former Song Dynasty survived, and they did not die from natural disasters.
Zhu Youjian felt that what Sun Chuanting said made sense. Now that he had money, there were new ways to make money from selling oil, so he couldn't miss it.
title_en: Chapter 2264: Oil can still be sold for money Chapter 2263: Ten jumps in a row
